system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: A TransformationDefiner agent receives three inputs: (1) a system prompt specifying the transformation-definition task, (2) the original training pairs, and (3) the compressed exploration summaries.
system_prompt_style.note: Orchestrator prompt code not in bundle. The refinement prompt is prepended when refinement begins ('an augmented prompt is placed at the beginning of context'), which could argue for dynamically_composed.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Phase 1 runs identically and seeds an initial set of pattern findings, after which an augmented definer-as-orchestrator agent runs with five tools available throughout
env_context_strategy.note: Task grids and explorer summaries are injected up front, and explorers are spawned on demand. The value list is SWE-oriented, so this is the closest fit.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The N synthesis outputs are compressed into a single artifact of approximately 4k tokens per explorer
context_compaction.note: Explorer trajectories are condensed into markdown summaries. There is no history condenser within the definer loop.

observation_format.evidence_quote: all share the same ASCII grid format so the architectural lift isn't confounded by prompt format.
observation_format.note: Grids presented as ASCII text; feedback appears as plain user message in trace. No line number available in bundle.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: explore_new_patterns(guidance) : spawn K=2 focused PatternExplorer agents conditioned on a structured guidance string from the orchestrator.
tool_call_format.note: The parser code for src/orchestrator is not in the bundle, so this is inferred from the named tools with arguments.

tool_count.evidence_quote: an augmented definer-as-orchestrator agent runs with five tools available throughout
tool_count.note: The five tools are think, define_transformation, submit_refined_transformation, explore_new_patterns and done. Explorers have 2 tools (think, note_pattern).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: submit_refined_transformation(what_changed, code) : a structured output tool for refining a previous transformation, fitted with a field to describe the refinement and a field containing the actual refined Python transformation.
edit_primitive.note: The model emits a full transform() function each time. There is no repository file editing.

tool_schema_source.note: The tool schema definitions in src/orchestrator are not in the bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file or source grep is available in the bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: A single agentic loop replaces the pipeline's directed Phase 2 entirely.
loop_primitives.note: Phase 1 explorers run first, then a react definer loop scores against train pairs and refines. M=5 parallel definers are selected by train score.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: think(thought): private scratchpad, identical to the pipeline definer's.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: give the definer a tool to spawn a smaller fleet of fresh, focused exploration mid-loop
multi_agent_topology.note: There is also an upstream explorer->definer pipeline stage.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: explore_new_patterns(guidance) : spawn K=2 focused PatternExplorer agents conditioned on a structured guidance string from the orchestrator.

human_in_loop.note: The orchestrator run loop is not in the bundle.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: think(thought) : a scratchpad tool that lets the agent record intermediate observations, hypotheses, and reasoning traces without committing to any output.
short_term_state.note: Explorer note_pattern logs are also kept.

long_term_memory.note: No source code is available to check cross-run memory. The Postgres DB is used for tracking only.

state_persistence.note: The run code is not in the bundle.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Each candidate program is run on every training input and scored by exact-match accuracy on the corresponding training output

retry_policy.note: The definer retries until train accuracy reaches 100% or the cap is hit. M=5 independent attempts are also run.

rollback.note: No filesystem is modified, and no code is available to check.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: (1) a structural exit when train-set accuracy reaches 100% on a candidate program, (2) an agent-mediated done call, or (3) one of three fuses
termination_condition.note: The consecutive exec-error fuse is also a stop condition.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Explorers are given a generous per-agent token budget ( ∼100k tokens)

timeouts.evidence_quote: Definer-generated Python is executed in a restricted subprocess with a 10-second per-call timeout

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Definer-generated Python is executed in a restricted subprocess

filesystem_access.note: The sandbox code is not in the bundle.

network_policy.evidence_quote: a small allowed-import list (numpy, standard library), and no network access.

tracing.evidence_quote: All runs are recorded in a local Postgres database (source of truth); per-agent JSON is also written to disk.
